This is a senior-level backend engineering role at Everest Technologies focused on Akeneo PIM, building event-driven microservices and integrations around product catalog systems for global retail commerce. The work involves supporting the live Akeneo PIM platform as a system of record, building stream-processing pipelines and connectors, and modeling product hierarchies, variants, and delta calculations. The core stack is Java/Spring Boot with Node.js/TypeScript, Go, or Python as alternatives, Apache Kafka (plus RabbitMQ and IBM MQ) for messaging, relational and NoSQL stores including Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis, and Kubernetes/Docker deployments on GCP, AWS, or Azure.
